task: Implement GitHub issue #18 in the static React ebook viewer: in single-page (portrait) view, e.g. 390x844, a short drag from the left edge of the page (8-40px) turns BACK a page on release instead of returning. Root cause confirmed in a browser: page-flip 2.0.7 stopMove completes a turn when the fold position x <= 0, and in portrait every backward fold on screen has x <= 0. Fix in the existing controller.stopMove wrapper in Viewer.tsx onInit: when not hovering, orientation is portrait, the fold direction is BACK and pos.x > -pageWidth/2, call the existing dropFold(flip) instead of page-flip's stopMove, so a backward drag turns only once past the middle of the visible page. Add getDirection to the getCalculation type. No new files or dependencies; do not patch node_modules.

context.observed_behavior: Reproduced on main 39944ce at 390x844: left-bottom +40px drag -> #/p/45 to #/p/44, 3/3, mouse and touch, 1 and 15 steps; +8px also turns. stopMove saw direction=BACK, pos.x=-47.9. 1440x900 short drags return. A runtime-injected version of the fix kept short drags on #/p/45 while +220px/+300px drags, corner clicks and forward behaviour were unchanged.
